## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The text is also cited or mentioned in later literature, specifically in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 7.7.4, *Pavanaṅgapañha*) [SuttaCentral].
SuttaCentral identifies curated parallels to the verses in both the Pali canon and Chinese Buddhist literature. Pali parallels include the *Sagāthāsutta* of the *Dhātu Saṁyutta* (SN 14.16), the *Vimalattheragāthā* (Thag 3.16), and the *Dhātusosaṁsandana Sutta* of the *Itivuttaka* (Iti 78 / It 3.29) [SuttaCentral]. Cross-tradition parallels include verse counterparts in the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (SA 446 and SA 448) as well as T 765.113 [SuttaCentral].
Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse corresponding to the curated canonical parallels, showing that segments §0.4–2.5 share nearly identical wording with Iti 78 (§6.2–8.4) and SN 14 (§16.9.3–16.11.4) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus records four matches between segments §0.4–2.5 of the text and its traditional commentary in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (first part, §3454–3459) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
